b20_theorem.consequence: |V(B)| >= 21 for either Pi0 bridge role (combined with B19 excluding |V(B)|=19); |V(G)| >= 21+21-2 = 40 for a Pi0-realizing Type-B configuration
b20_theorem.formalization_status: no proof-assistant formalization exists for B19, B20, or this consequence
b20_theorem.scope_caveat: stated narrowly for configurations that reduce to the Pi0 tuple (2,2,4,4,1,1) under the established bridge-reduction machinery; not claimed for Type-B in general

completed_range_statement: Family I: complete (86047/86047 candidates checked, exhaustive). Family II: complete (54/54 candidates found by two independently coded exhaustive generators, canonical sets identical, cross-verified by a third independent method).

family_i.conclusion: Family I (2,3^18) is empty: 86047/86047 candidates contain a C8. Four independent detectors agree (Python DFS, networkx, C from-scratch DFS unit-tested separately, SAT encoding validated on synthetic trials).

sat_cross_validation.note: sat_ham_path_from vs has_ham_path_from: 200 random trials, 0 disagreements. sat_cycle_len_exists vs DFS+networkx: 100 trials x {C4,C8}, 0 disagreements. Synthetic validation of the SAT encodings themselves, not run exhaustively over all 86047 candidates (unnecessary once stage-1 C8/C16 already eliminates 100% of candidates by two other independent detectors plus the C implementation).

abandoned_broad_search.naive_single_threaded_attempt: timeout 300 nauty-geng -c -q -f -d2 -D4 19 28:28 -u did not complete (SIGTERM, exit 143)
abandoned_broad_search.prefix_inspection: first 8287530 graphs generated by an unsharded run (subsequently stopped) contained zero matches for the exact 2^2,3^16,4 degree profile; not used as evidence of absence
abandoned_broad_search.reason_geng_direct_generation_infeasible: nauty-geng only supports global min/max degree bounds (-d/-D), not exact per-vertex degree counts. The -d2 -D4 19 28:28 box includes every degree profile with deviation-from-3 summing to -1, not just the 2^2,3^16,4 profile.
abandoned_broad_search.sharded_attempt: geng res/mod 4-way sharding + streaming degree filter was started, then abandoned (killed, 0 CPU-minutes wasted beyond ~14 min) in favor of the exact slot-matching model once it was designed; not required once the two exact generators agree.

canonical_comparison.symmetry: path reversal p_i <-> p_17-i, a<->y, z fixed, degree-4 role mapped accordingly

family_ii.conclusion: Family II (2^2,3^16,4) is empty: all 54 exhaustively-generated candidates are eliminated by an internal C16, a closure C8, and a closure C16 simultaneously. Two independently coded generators agree exactly; a third independent method confirms every claim.

direct_generator.self_check_result: all 54 completions independently re-checked C4-free and C8-free (consistent with incremental pruning); all 54 contain an internal C16; all 54 have both a simple length-6 and length-14 a-y path
direct_generator.symmetry_check: role j and role (17-j) always agree under path reversal (unplanned, emergent consistency check): (1,16)=(0,0) (2,15)=(0,0) (3,14)=(3,3) (4,13)=(1,1) (5,12)=(4,4) (6,11)=(4,4) (7,10)=(5,5) (8,9)=(8,8)

independent_verifier.method: networkx only; does not call either generator internal function; re-derives vertex/edge counts, connectivity, degree sequence, path presence, role, C4/C8/C16, and both closing-path witnesses from the saved candidate file alone

family_ii.model: exact slot-matching: fixed 18-vertex path p0..p17 (p0=a,p17=y) + off-path vertex z, 11 non-path edges, 17 possible degree-4 roles (p1..p16 or z), derived from the excess-counting argument in type_b_one_slack_resolution.md Section 1

sat_generator.command: python3 -c "from verifier.type_b_slack_path_sat import sat_family_ii_search_role" (looped over all 17 roles)
sat_generator.encoding: CardEnc.equals (seqcounter) per-vertex exact-degree constraints + total-edge-count=11 constraint; CEGAR loop against verifier/cycle_detect.py find_cycle_len_dfs for C4/C8, independent of the C generator

family_ii.terminal_closing_offset_audit: a simple a-y path of length r in R plus edges xa,xy closes to a cycle of length r+2 (two closing edges, not one); r=6 gives C8, r=14 gives C16; all 54 candidates verified to have both paths with the correct lengths (not r+1)

scope_honesty: Family I and Family II are both fully eliminated by exhaustive, cross-validated computation. Theorem B20 (no eligible 20-vertex Pi0 bridge) is proved. |V(G)|>=40 is claimed narrowly for Pi0-reducing Type-B configurations only -- not for Type-B in general.
stopping_outcome: Outcome 1: two independent exact generators agree exactly (identical canonical SHA-256) and B20 is proved.
title: One-slack Pi0 bridge: 28-edge remainder layer resolution (Family I and Family II complete, B20 proved)
